decisions.reason: Although it connects loosely to the firm's maritime customer base, submarine interior lighting is a niche and more distant product with only limited website prominence, so management would likely reallocate resources away from it.
Medical examination lights build directly on the firm's lighting know-how and professional institutional customer base, and the dedicated product page suggests a serious commitment worth continuing.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's industrial focus, engineering capabilities and certification strengths very well, making them a strong product to retain.
The designer task light is close to the existing range and was presented as a relaunch of a popular product, so it is likely to stay unless performance disappoints.
